description: A shell script for testing git submodule rebasing, stashing, and related operations, including setup, various rebase and stash scenarios, as well as verification steps.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specific setup.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test environment's clock to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of files or outputs with expected values.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail; used to test negative cases.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
